notes: Structured summary of the public NeurIPS review form. Not a verbatim copy of the reviewer guidelines.

subdimensions.label: Quality
subdimensions.guidance: Technical soundness, appropriateness of the evaluation and support for the claims.

subdimensions.label: Clarity
subdimensions.guidance: Writing quality, organization and reproducibility of the described method.

subdimensions.label: Significance
subdimensions.guidance: Importance of the problem and likely impact of the results on the field.

subdimensions.label: Originality
subdimensions.guidance: Novelty relative to the closest prior work, including new formulations, data or analyses.

deskRejectRules: The submission violates the main-track page limit or appendix rules.
The submission is not anonymized when required.
The submission is out of scope or is not a research paper.
The submission attempts to manipulate the review process.

template.summary: Summarize the paper and its claimed contributions in one paragraph.
template.strengths: State concrete strengths with locations in the paper.
template.weaknesses: State concrete weaknesses with locations in the paper; distinguish missing evidence from disagreement with the approach.
template.questions: Ask focused questions that the authors could answer in a rebuttal.
template.limitations: Discuss limitations of the method, evaluation and claims.

rubric.summary: A good summary shows that the reviewer read the paper rather than the abstract alone.
rubric.quality: Check whether the experiments test the claims, whether baselines are strong, and whether uncertainty is reported.
rubric.clarity: Check whether the method, hyperparameters and evaluation protocol are specified well enough to reproduce.
rubric.significance: A incremental result can still be significant if it changes practice or enables a new line of work.
rubric.originality: Reward new problem formulations and analyses, not only new architectures.
rubric.deskReject: Desk rejection is a scope, format, anonymity or integrity decision.
